title: Eventide (novel)
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Wizards of the Coast novels)

paragraphs.text: Eventide is the second book of the Shadowmoor Cycle . It was written by Scott McGough and Cory Herndon . It was published on June 3, 2008.
No sun will rise over the world of Shadowmoor , and all but a precious few have forgotten the daylit world that once was.
In the perpetual night of Shadowmoor, a few brave heroes will fight the world itself for a last glimmer of light.
